limitations: Actual native takeoff and browser ground states were exercised. Landing, bounce, ground stop and Review-prefix event rules have synthetic unit coverage, not a validated native full circuit.
Physical model is unchanged generic JSBSim C172P research data, not a validated C172S.
Model/runtime closure is deliberately not redistributed; copied build metadata identifies the observed executable but cannot reconstruct all embedded inputs.
Map/photo pixels use local fixtures; terrain and native worker are real. No source-wide, training, regulatory or cross-provider acceptance is inferred.
Runway context is session-only; imported recordings without it hide the practice card.
